notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Move Animals & More UI Polish (13.06.2025) 🐄🐈
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey settlers 👋[/b][/p][p]This update is a smaller one, but it brings one long-awaited feature: You can now move animals between barns, homes, and even maps! Perfect for reorganizing your herds or giving that chicken a nicer view. 🐓[/p][p]We’ve also made several UI improvements, fixed bugs, and added quality-of-life tweaks.[/p][p]
[b]🐾 New Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]Move animals between barns, homes, and maps![/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]✨ Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI: Clearer category highlighting in the construction menu[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Optional needs are now better color-coded[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Resource bar now supports up to three columns[/p][/*][*][p]Text fixes for Japanese localization[/p][/*][*][p]Default pet is now a cat instead of a raccoon[/p][/*][*][p]Music: Balanced how often short tracks are repeated[/p][/*][*][p]“Skip Intro” now skips the welcome screen as well[/p][/*][*][p]Free animal button now located with other window controls[/p][/*][*][p]Street/demolish tools remember your selection on new game load[/p][/*][*][p]Improved map names in Kerzoven-B[/p][/*][*][p]Faster body heat recovery in ideal temperatures[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed child showing "died of old age" 😬[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved storage reset issue on reload[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weird gibberish when no worker was available for hire[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes fixed related to animals dying during interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed faction wealth being incorrectly initialized by multiple marketplaces[/p][/*][*][p]Slight storage increase for fireplace, farm & gatherer[/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update – More Music, Wolves as Pets & Improvements (05.06.2025) 🐺
notes.notes:
[b]Hey settlers 👋[/b]

Thank you for the continuous feedback! 🥰  We reviewed over 70 musicians and could acquire over one hour of fantastic new music from the talented Loïc Leclair and Yurii Panivan! This provides much greater variety in the music, even during long sessions. 🎶  You can also tame wolves and have them as pets in your homes! Of course, we also fixed various issues and crashes. 🛠️

[b]Patch Notes: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Added over one hour of new music from Loïc Leclair and Yurii Panivan[/b]
[*] Improved the description for energy reserves.
[*] Made the color indicator for good values in the plant UI better visible and less gray-ish.
[*] Fixed an issue where foxes could not be tamed when they already have a burrow home.
[*] [b]You can now tame wolves and have them as pets.[/b]
[*] Improved the habitat AI when animals are pets.
[*] People can now care more for their pets if they feel lonely.
[*] You get now a flat 5 people event immigration every spring stacking up to two times.
[*] An issue has been fixed where you could not invite people when you had event immigration but the village attractiveness was very low.
[*] Increased the temperature range of the Finn torch and the Windcatcher Tower.
[*] Slightly buffed the temperature values of the Finn Torch and Windcatcher Tower.
[*] The building entry markers are now better visible on snow.
[*] The UI will no longer show quick notifications if the QuickNotificationDuration is set to 0.1s or lower in the settings.
[*] Sheep's wool can now be collected more quickly.

[b]Crashes:[/b]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when the user looked at the AI status tooltip while an animal was interacting with another animal that had just died.
[*] Fixed a crash when the user changed the workplace priority at the same time a worker quit the job / died.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when destroying buildings very quickly.
[/list]

Enjoy the new tracks and let us know what your wolf companion is called! 🐺🎶
As always, leaving a Steam review helps us a lot! [b]Thank you![/b] 💚

[u][b]Team Of Life and Land 🦊[/b][/u]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update – Improved UI, Better Explanations & Helpful New Features 30.05.2025
notes.notes:
Hey settlers👋

Thank you for all the feedback! This helped us to see what information is missing and what can be understood in which way. With this patch we added a lot of new information about the different systems in the game, more guidelines, tips and additional wiki entries with examples for common questions we’ve received.
We also implemented many new features requested by our players to make the game even more fun and easier to use. Of course we also fixed issues and crashes reported to us.

[b]📚 New Explanations, Help & UI Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] More info for buildings like: Stonemason, Smelter, Gatherers Shack, Farm, Beehive, Barn, and more,
[/list]
New help views on:
[list]
[*] How to delete things
[*] How pollution & heat work
[*] How to get food
[*] How the marketplace works
[/list]
[list]
[*] Warnings for common marketplace config mistakes
[*] Clearer feedback for work-related problems & specializations
[*] Improved info on why villagers died, how fields/weirs work, and how to increase efficiency
[*] New counter in the construction UI to show how many of a building exist
[*] Many small UI fixes and help text additions across the board
[/list]
[b]🌧️ Balance & Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]

[list]
[*] Less flooding in default scenario (less rain, fewer springs)
[*] Root Cellar now uses open dairy as source even if stock is low
[*] Rebalanced marketplace upgrades and dairy upgrade power
[*] Water now washes off dirt in the Lenzburg Castle
[*] Improved survival chances of NPC villages in Kerzoven scenarios
[*] Fishery can now clean their landing stage
[*] Several visual/UI layout adjustments for clarity
[/list]

[b]🐞 Crash Fixes:[/b]

Fixed crashes related to:
[list]
[*] Visual updates during agent removal
[*] Cats hunting dead targets
[*] Editor water bodies during startup
[*] Apprentices removed during job search
[*] Rare engine-level multithreading edge cases
[*] Dynamic level timers
[/list]

[b]🧰 Modding Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Made critical fields read-only and thread-safe
[*] Defensive copies for mesh batching to avoid engine-level crashes
[*] World timers are now protected
[*] More stability for complex mods interacting with multithreading
[/list]

Once again, thank you for your help and support! your feedback shapes the game every week!
If you play Of Life and Land, we’d love it if you could take a moment to leave a Steam review. It really helps more than you think. 💚

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 30.05.2025 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Here are the complete patch notes for the: 🛠️ Update – Improved UI, Better Explanations & Helpful New Features 30.05.2025

[list]
[*] Added more information about the Stonemason Shop, Smelter, Bloomery, Gatherers Shack, Farm, Forester, Beehive, Barn, Small Cabin and Shrine.
[*] Added a new help view to explain how to delete things, how the pollution works, how the heat works, how to get food and how to buy something from the marketplace.
[*] Balanced the water in the default scenario: Less rain in the mountains. Less springs on the start map = less floods. Moved water drainage in hills. Reduce winter rain on the start map. Made the AI a little more resistant to extinction.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The Root Cellar now also considers the open dairy as a source even if the stock is not that high.
[*] Fixed a missing description for the mountain pass.
[*] Fixed an issue where the trade change event to solve the tutorial was not triggering correctly if it was set as a text without pressing enter.
[*] Improved the weather event data in the default scenario.
[*] Tutorial: Saving the done status for fields and trees as well.
[*] Improved the help UI.
[*] Added warnings to the marketplace trade entry if 'sell over' or 'provide over' is set to 0 and explain what it means in detail.
[*] Improved the wiki trade entry visual.
[*] Added an info hint if no worker could be found to hire in a location. Also added additional help if work specialization is activated in the guild house.
[*] Added an option so that the right mouse button does not deselect construction blueprints.
[*] The road and delete tool in the bottom bar now toggle if they are selected a second time.
[*] Added a counter in the construction UI to see how many instances you already have of this kind on your map.
[*] Explain more how the marketplace storage works and what its limits are.
[*] Added more help text to the cell side constructions on how to remove them again.
[*] Added more help text to the Finn torch on how it works.
[*] Added more info about why someone has died.
[*] Made it more clear on how the weir works.
[*] Made it more clear on how the fields work and how to increase efficiency.
[*] Slightly improved the text margins in the construction UI.
[*] The building range text hint also shows if there is something bad in range like another beehive next to the red building marker.
[*] The building range text hint no longer takes into account targets that would be replaced by the building.
[*] [b]Improvements:[/b]
[*] The fishery can now also clean their landing stage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the weather events could apply to a different map than the starting map.
[*] Kerzoven: Increased gold rewards a bit. Applied to all Kerzoven scenarios.
[*] Improved survival chances for NPC villages in the Kerzoven Scenario. Now it should be quite difficult to get them extinct.
[*] Balanced the market place upgrades.
[*] The water can now wash off the dirt in the Lenzburg castle, keeping it clean.
[*] The camera now preserves the zoom level when you follow something and then select the next target to follow.
[*] Food crates and material places now more often check if they can be safely removed when they are empty.
[*] Added two more entries for the hunters hut.
[*] Made the dairy upgrades much, much stronger.
[*] [b]Crashes:[/b]
[*] Fixed a potential rare crash when the visual update was still going on while an agent was removed.
[*] Fixed a rare potential crash when the cat tried to hunt a target that just died in the same moment as it was inspected.
[*] Fixed a potential rare crash in the dynamic level timer only curing on very specific systems with lots of interrupts.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the the editor could crash when a water body tried to register at startup in the same time while being replaced with another water body by the user.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could crash when an apprentice was looking for a job and was removed by the user with the editor tools at the exact same time.
[*] [b]Modding:[/b]
[*] Modding: Ensure the world timers are read only.
[*] Modding: Added a defensive copy to the mesh array builder to prevent a potential rare crash where the engine released the mesh cache while it was batched.
[*] Modding: Made critical fields read-only and added defensive copies in the DynamicObjectBehaviour to ensure it works well with mods editing this area in a multi threaded context.
[/list]

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix: Crash Fixes & Improvements - 22.05.2025 📝
notes.notes:
[b]Hey settlers 👋[/b]

Here’s another small update focused on stability, balance, and small UI improvements. Thanks again for your feedback and crash reports! 💚

[b]🥰 Reviews[/b]
As always, we would be super happy if you could let us know how you liked Of Life and Land with a review.

[b]🔧 Improvements & Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased default inventory space of the open dairy to better interact with root cellar storage.
[*] Increased Twitch emote duration.
[*] Balanced wheat field and garden bed: better flood resistance and deeper root access.
[*] The church and cathedral can now prepare services using milk or wine instead of only honey.
[*] Added separate storage for fruits and exotic fruits to reduce storage conflicts.
[*] Slightly adjusted groundwater values under waterfalls.
[*] Buffed immigration bonuses for T1–T3 and slightly reduced them for T6–T7.
[*] Improved UI visibility for road & deconstruction tools.
[*] Made inactive spin boxes in the market less transparent for better clarity.
[*] Fixed a bug where wheat fields appeared fully grown in the UI while flooded.
[/list]

[b]🐞 Crash Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when inspecting the faith or thirst need of a deceased villager.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by uninitialized agent positions during dirt simulation.
[*] Fixed a crash in the world timer by marking certain data fields as immutable.
[*] Fixed a graphics pipeline issue caused by background apps interfering.
[/list]

Thanks for helping us make Of Life and Land what it is today 🌾

[u][b]Your Team Kerzoven 🥰[/b][/u]

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.0 is Here! – Play the New Lenzburg Scenario! 🎉
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Settlers 👋 [/b]
After one year of steady development, over 20 major updates, and your amazing feedback, we’re excited to announce that Of Life and Land is now officially released as version 1.0 on Steam and available at 40% off to celebrate the launch! 🥳

Please support us on this special day! ❤️ 
[list]
[*] Buy the game (for a friend)
[*] Or help us even more by getting our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39633/Of_Life_and_Land__Supporter_Edition/]Supporter Edition[/url]
[*] Write a review on Steam
[*] Share our release [url=https://x.com/kerzoven]posts[/url]
[/list]
All these actions help us more than you think! 🥰

[h3]🛠️ Some of the biggest features added since Early Access[/h3]
[list]
[*] Physical 💩dirt and humidity simulation. ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/4199119061813842922]Trailer & Patch Notes[/url])
[*] New trade focused scenario Risenna with 11 new maps ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BaRzhdw3F_4]Trailer[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/601890524829320573]Patch Notes[/url])
[*] Two fully simulated animals that influence the ecosystem: 🐔[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/601890524829320573]Chickens[/url] and 🐟[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/4155212408110686107]pike[/url].
[*] Simulated education & retirement system: ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/6904675658203398216]Patch Notes[/url])
[*] Lots of new buildings such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/6904675658203398216]the guild house[/url] and several [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1733110/view/577128955243397619]faith buildings[/url].
[*] And many more content and improvements in [b]over 20 feature updates.[/b]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733110/Of_Life_and_Land/?

[h3]🏰 New in the 1.0 Release: The Counts of Lenzburg Scenario[/h3]
Step into a historical conflict between empire and church in a brand new scenario set in the Central Plateau of medieval Switzerland.  Build the mighty Lenzburg Castle on Dragon Rock , manage trade routes, uncover ancient myths, and shape your own chapter in history.

[b]This release also brings:[/b]

[*]Marking animals, humans or buildings on the map will temporarily mark it as well in the world if object marking is enabled.
[*]Prevented animation jump after unpause.
[*]Fixed a case where an animation could freeze.
[*]Slightly balanced the community centre material requirement.
[*]Fixed a crash when you delete a market place in the exact moment a buy/sell transaction is executed.
[*]Fixed a crash when someone tries to leave the map but the map transition got deleted in the editor.
[*]We are using three autosave slots to be able to go back three days / 30 min.
[*]The heat mini map is now immediately initialized with data.
[*]Employment view is now initially sorted by workplaces.
[*]Workplaces are initially sorted when the tab is pressed and not already when the view is opened.
[/list]

notes.title: 💩 Pollution & Humidity Update - EA 2024.04.22 🌧️
notes.notes:
[b]Hey settlers👋,[/b]
Today is the official Earth Day! 🎉 🌍 
That's why we're bringing you our first update today with some new content on the topic of visible environmental impacts.

[b]💩Physical dirt simulation:[/b]
Polluted areas are now recognisable as such and plants will die if they are too contaminated.

[b]🌧️  Physical humidity simulation:[/b]
Wet areas are identifiable by rich colours. Dry areas are recognisable by faded colours. In addition, the shine of the ground adapts to the amount of humidity.

[b]But, check it out yourself:[/b]
[previewyoutube=rd-q00oVkE8;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you like the update and the better visibility of the dirt and water simulation! Stay tuned for the next update where we also plan UI improvements like a better production overview and sorting options.

[b][u]Your Team Kerzoven 🥰 [/u][/b]
[h3][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Plants now have a visual model when they wilt and are too polluted.
[*]Polluted areas now visually get more dirty and brown, while very clean areas get slightly brighter
[*]Wet areas get visually more wet, saturated and shiny, while dry areas get less saturated, slightly grayish and less shiny.
[*]Added more checks to see if a save path is valid
[*]Fixed an issue when someone wants to leave the map, but the map transition was removed in the editor
[*]Fixed a rare crash when a group leader got demoted in the exact time an user is opening the UI
[*]Added more ground tiles for floor type transitions, reflecting seasonal change.
[*]Made sure to reset the weather visuals when you switch from the editor to the game
[*]Added flipped stairs / level transition paths.
[/list]
